name: Username Validation
description: Adds admin-configurable validation rules (min/max length, blacklisted characters/words, no-spaces) to the username field on user registration and profile edit, with optional AJAX feedback.
project_description: Username Validation lets a site administrator enforce simple rules on the account name field of the user registration and profile-edit forms: a minimum and maximum character count, a comma-separated blacklist of forbidden characters and words, and an option to disallow spaces. It can also relabel and re-describe the username field on the registration form and, optionally, show the same errors live via AJAX on the field's change event. Rules are applied through a form_alter validate handler on user_register_form and user_form; they are not entity-level constraints, so programmatic account creation is not affected.
